_comment: Simplified Chinese (Mainland China) texts for the German table spirlings. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.%s and %s sing together. Their call gath:
%s和%s一同歌唱。它们的歌声汇聚成一颗漂浮的回声核心。
带着它走吧：在泉水边休息几次或赢下许多场战斗后，它就会苏醒。
strings.%s looks back once, then runs off into t: %s回头看了一眼，然后跑进了草丛。
strings.A Blotling that read every page of Mirel: 一只读遍了Mirela地图册每一页的Blotling。
strings.A Brinelet that grew through three dry s: 一只熬过三个干旱夏天成长起来的Brinelet。
strings.A Croziel that finally unrolled, frond b: 一只终于一片一片舒展开叶子的Croziel。
一个初始之声独自歌唱。
strings.A Fluting that played through one long S: 一只在Saltmarsh漫长的黄昏里吹奏不停的Fluting。
strings.A Hushkin that heard ten perfect echoes: 一只听到十次完美回声、并以光芒作答的Hushkin。
strings.A Kelpup that found a pearl and grew aro: 一只找到珍珠、并围绕它的光芒成长的Kelpup。
strings.A Kindlop that kept the lighthouse fire: 一只守护灯塔之火整整一个季节的Kindlop。
strings.A Paddlewisp that guided a ferry through: 一只引导渡轮度过整个风暴季的Paddlewisp。
strings.A Seamlet that saw its own Rift mended a: 一只终于看到自己的裂隙被修复的Seamlet。
strings.A Talusk that carried its first waymark: 一只把第一块路标石背上Crowcrest的Talusk。
strings.A Zippit that caught the lighthouse beam: 一只抓住灯塔光束并留住了它的Zippit。
strings.A beacon fire burns on its top stone. On: 它最上面的石头上燃着烽火。在漆黑的夜晚，它会爬上山脊，好让旅人找到路。
strings.A drop of the lighthouse lake that never: 一滴从不愿下沉的灯塔湖水。
strings.A gust that got lost between the hills a: 一阵在山丘间迷了路、就此留下的风。
strings.A heap of Crowcrest scree that woke up w: 一堆睁开一只灰眼睛醒来的Crowcrest碎石。
strings.A hollow reed of the Saltmarsh that lear: 一根学会了风之歌的Saltmarsh空心芦苇。
strings.A light rises from under the lake by the: 岸边的湖水下升起一道光。
strings.A piece of a Crowcrest mountain lake tha: 一片倒映着天空的Crowcrest山间小湖。
strings.A spark that jumped from the edge of a R: 一点从裂隙边缘迸出的火花。
strings.A spark that jumped off the first storm: 一点从Brindlewick上空第一场风暴中迸出的火花。
strings.A young %s wakes, still humming the song: 一只年幼的%s醒来了，还哼着%s的歌。
strings.A young fern frond of the Fernstair that: 一片Fernstair的嫩蕨叶，从未停止卷曲。
strings.After a dry summer it stands like a whit: 干旱的夏天过后，它像一根白色柱子立在滩涂上。水手们靠它辨别航向。
strings.At dusk its song carries across the whol: 黄昏时，它的歌声传遍整片沼泽，芦苇都朝它弯下腰来聆听。
strings.Born from the Hush itself, the silence t: 诞生于沉寂本身，那降临在Veydal的寂静。
strings.Born in a lamp left burning through a lo: 诞生于一盏燃过漫长冬天的灯中。
对身边的每个人都小心体贴。
strings.Chipped off the Crowcrest cliffs on a co: 在一个寒冷的夜晚从Crowcrest悬崖上剥落下来。
strings.Crawled out of Mirela's old inkwells in: 从灯塔里Mirela的旧墨水瓶中爬了出来。
strings.Dug its way up from the dark under Murk: 从Murk Hollow底下的黑暗中一路挖了上来。
最爱的Spirling永远不会被放生。
strings.Favourites stay where they are. Move the: 最爱的Spirling会留在原处。请逐只移动。
strings.Followed the lighthouse lights to Brindl: 第一个风暴之夜追随灯塔的光来到了Brindlewick。
strings.Found where lamp light falls on still wa: 出没于灯光洒落在静水上的地方。
strings.Grows in the strong currents below the S: 生长在Saltmarsh堤坝下的湍流中。
strings.If you trip over a Talusk it rolls toget: 如果你被Talusk绊倒，它会重新缩成一团，有点不高兴地朝你眨眼。
strings.It copies any line it sees onto the near: 它会把看到的每一条线都抄到最近的墙上。擦掉的话，Blotling会一脸受伤。
strings.It draws maps of places it has never bee: 它会画出从未去过的地方的地图。按图走过的旅人说，路都是对的。
strings.It follows the lighthouse beam as it swe: 它追随着扫过海岸的灯塔光束。自从第一场风暴以来，它就再没离开过Brindlewick。
strings.It goes home for good. Really release it: 它将永远回到故乡。真的要放生吗？
strings.It has no voice at all. When it is glad,: 它完全没有声音。高兴时，额头上的印记会稍微亮一些。
strings.It hums a note you have heard before, in: 它哼着一个你曾经听过的音——在灯室里，Mirela的地图册翻开的时候。
strings.It only shows itself when there is no wi: 它只在完全无风时现身。那时，它的背上承载着整片天空。
strings.It sleeps rolled up tight. In spring a w: 它睡觉时缩得紧紧的。到了春天，满山坡的它们会同时舒展开来。
strings.It speaks only in floating signs of ligh: 它只用漂浮的光之符号说话。学会读懂这些符号的人，再也不会感到孤单。
strings.It stacks one path stone on its back for: 每把一个迷路的旅人带回家，它就在背上叠一块路石。
strings.It tries to sew the Rifts shut with thre: 它试图用光之线把裂隙缝上。线总是不牢，所以它一直在尝试。
strings.Its antlers are open fern fronds. Each y: 它的角是展开的蕨叶。每年都会长出一片新的。
strings.Its sails catch every gust. Ferry crews: 它的帆能兜住每一阵风。渡轮船员会在船头留一个空位，以防它想搭船。
strings.Its stone hardened deep in the cliff, fa: 它的石头在远离一切光亮的悬崖深处变得坚硬。
strings.Its thorns grew to guard the young ferns: 它的刺是为守护Fernstair的幼蕨而长出来的。
strings.Lives under Aldo's ferry and was born in: 住在Aldo的渡船底下，诞生于它的尾波之中。
strings.Needs: %d perfect Echo calls in the team: 需要：队伍中%d次完美回声呼唤
strings.Needs: a mended Rift: 需要：一道已修复的裂隙
什么新鲜事都要凑上去闻闻。
strings.Old tales say it carries the lake's ligh: 古老的传说称，它会把湖的光带到深处。
strings.On stormy nights it pushes small boats g: 暴风雨之夜，它会把小船轻轻推回栈桥，然后在别人道谢之前转身离去。
strings.One of the six First Voices, whose silen: 六个初始之声之一，它们的沉默让沉寂笼罩了大地。
strings.Only Spirlings with you or in storage ca: 只有队伍中或寄存处的Spirling才能歌唱。
strings.Only a Mirkmole that saw Murk Hollow's d: 只有见过Murk Hollow黑暗的Mirkmole才会这样成长。
strings.Rain makes it shrink and sulk. A dry sum: 下雨时它会缩小并闹别扭。干旱的夏天能让它长高将近一掌。
strings.Rides out every storm on the coast and r: 能挺过海岸上的每一场风暴，毫发无伤地归来。
strings.Spirlog goal: %d kinds bonded! You recei: Spirlog目标：已结缘%d种！你获得了%d金币。
strings.Sprouts where a Wayfarer once rested und: 在旅人曾于蕨叶下歇息过的地方萌芽。
这支队伍现在无法出行。
strings.The First Voice of Veydal. It sleeps as: Veydal的初始之声。它化作一道光沉睡在湖底，很久以前用歌声将这片土地连在一起。它是最后一个见到Mirela的。
strings.The last flicker of a candle that a chil: 一根孩子不肯吹灭的蜡烛最后的火光。
strings.The light sinks back under the water. It: 光沉回了水下。你休息之后它会再次升起。
strings.The light takes shape. It is Velahra, th: 光凝聚成形。那是Velahra，Veydal的初始之声。它是最后一个见到Mirela的。
strings.The oldest waymark of the Crowcrest, sti: Crowcrest最古老的路标石，至今还在行走。
strings.The song in the Echo Core you carry grow: 你携带的回声核心中的歌声变得浑厚而清晰。
strings.The wind plays it like a flute. Lost wal: 风把它当作笛子吹奏。迷路的人跟着曲调走，最终会走上回家的路。
带一只同行来了解更多。
strings.Walks the shaded edge of the forest wher: 徘徊在森林阴暗的边缘，那里的苔藓变得深暗。
strings.Washed up in a knot of kelp after a high: 大潮过后被冲上岸，裹在一团海带里。
strings.Where a Rift was mended, a Mendlace stay: 裂隙修好的地方，会留下一只Mendlace，每晚检查接缝。
strings.You already carry as many Echo Cores as: 你已经带着最多数量的回声核心了。
